items: Start by deciding which areas you want to measure, such as guest experience, sales and revenue, labor, inventory or operations, because most platforms specialize in only some of them.
Good analytics should answer practical questions: which locations need attention, which menu items earn the most, whether labor costs fit revenue, and whether guests are satisfied.
Compare tools on the KPIs they track, integrations with your POS and other systems, multi-location dashboards, ease of use, forecasting, alerts and how well they scale.
Look beyond the monthly subscription when you budget, since POS integrations, hardware, implementation, extra locations and premium modules can all raise the total cost.
